svg.title: gradle-grill verdict on four ways to wire a generated source directory
svg.desc: Run at level medium. Rank 1, onVariants with variant.sources.kotlin.addGeneratedSourceDirectory: Recommended, build successful. Rank 2, withPlugin with sourceSets.named main java.srcDir and a provider: Avoid, build failed. Rank 3, finalizeDsl with sourceSets.getByName main java.srcDir and a provider: Avoid, build failed. Rank 4, the asker's line, afterEvaluate with sourceSets main java.srcDir generateTask.get().outputDir: Avoid, build failed. Ranks 2 to 4 failed on AGP 9.1.0 with: You cannot add Provider instances to the Android SourceSet API.
